statement: SK hynix states its V10 375-layer 4D NAND improves performance per watt by 2.5 times compared with the previous generation.
why: Storage efficiency gains matter because power, not floor space, is the limiting input in AI data centres, so every watt saved on storage is a watt available for accelerators.

impact.mechanism: Better performance per watt in NAND lowers the power drawn by the storage tier of an AI cluster, freeing power budget for compute.

evidence.excerpt: V10 375-layer 4D NAND improves performance per watt by 2.5 times compared to the previous generation

confidence.basis: Vendor claim in a company press release distributed by newswire, captured at secondary tier; no independent measurement.

dispersion: The figure is a ratio against an undisclosed prior generation baseline, not an absolute performance-per-watt level, so no value is recorded.
